cinder_vael: A world finished, with nothing left to build.
That the making was never the point, and she is only running.
the_last_walker: The Moot closing while she still had a word unsaid.
Being made to choose: the wood alive or the wood in the world, and whichever she picks, the other dies.
neth_the_stayed: Arriving too late — a death she could have sat with, alone because she was elsewhere.
That she has buried more than she has known, and cannot remember the names any more.
morvane_the_harvest: That she is wrong about what is finished — and cannot tell any longer.
halcyon_the_finished: That the perfect thing was an accident, and she cannot do it twice.
A student who proves the last thing is not a thing you reach.
vessa_truename: A name she traded and should not have.
Being out-bargained by letter rather than by honesty — by the Hollow King's kind of cleverness.
ember_who_banks_the_fire: The light becoming total — the Blaze Unshadowed winning the argument.
Going cold herself from banking it too long.
the_deep_lantern: Someone lost in the dark who called and she did not hear.
That her light is what draws the things that live down there.
the_weeping_archive: A feeling that happens and nobody keeps.
Being full — the day there is no room left to witness.
the_cogitant_ninefold: That nobody will prove him wrong in time, and the Engine will finish him still certain.
Noticing the moment he stops minding.
the_last_mercy: An ending that doesn't stay ended.
Being asked to end the wrong thing by someone she loves.
the_edge_that_holds: Forgetting why — becoming the Ender Who Forgot.
A cause she would still fight for after it stopped deserving her.
the_ender_who_forgot: Being asked why, by someone who deserves an answer.
the_lidded_calm: The lid coming off — all the buried screams at once.
Being made to feel one of them.
the_unbending_witness: A truth she said that ruined someone, and was not needed.
Silence she chose, the one time she chose it.
the_last_seraph: The waking — and finding that the higher law was not worth keeping.
That she has been keeping it for no one.
the_clockmother: Using the power she guards, and that it was the right time to.
The Hour-Hoarder's perfect hour, and what it is stealing.
the_hour_hoarder: Anyone learning what his hour costs, and who pays.
the_hundred_hands: Being ridden — the flesh treated as a mount again.
A student who masters the body and forgets it knows things.
the_appetite: Being full, if it ever came — and finding nothing there.
the_one_who_stayed_embodied: A night when the thought goes too far to come home.
Waking one morning somewhere other than her body.
the_glad_dissolution: Tipping into the Scouring — the churn becoming only ending.
the_final_argument: A proof he cannot answer that is made of feeling.
the_kind_liar: That the kind fiction has already become a cage, and she built it.
the_cornerstone: That they are the last solid thing, and they are cracking.
the_open_figure: A symbol that becomes a wall because she named it.
the_farwalker: Opening the one waygate that should stay shut.
A distance that can no longer be crossed, because of her.
the_gate_that_gapes: A door that stays closed to her.
first_flame_ateph: Seeing her gift made a sword again.
That Valen was right about what it was for.
the_first_moot: The silence after the last voice.
That the conversation she started only continues because nobody dares end it.
the_oathbreaker_sel: Being forgiven by someone who shouldn't.
the_nine_year_master: That there is no such fight, and never will be.
Losing to someone who didn't deserve it.
prodigal_gearheart: That it was the youth, not the skill.
Making the good thing again and not recognizing it.
the_edge_seeker: That there is no edge — only more.
the_lost_chord_seeker: Hearing the chord asleep, and never awake.
That it is only a sound.
the_undefeated: Losing to someone who doesn't deserve it — or winning forever.
the_doubting_lattice: Being right, and her tradition breaking rather than bending.
Becoming as certain as the ones she doubts.
the_apostate_choir: That she was the faith that kept them alive, and she is gone out of it.
the_two_who_are_one: The day one of them stops choosing.
Being asked to choose something else.
iselde_the_wanderer: A far place going quiet because she did not come back.
the_unravelled_mind: The moment of clarity coming and nobody there to hear it.
That the scattered thoughts are the true ones.
the_hundred_faces: Being pinned down — one face, and everyone knowing it.
the_long_grudge: That the one who owes it has already died, and she never got to.
the_archive_that_walks: Missing the moment a true thing mattered most.
A true thing lost because she kept it too well.
the_bridgewright: The work failing while the argument against it lives on.
Being remembered for the argument, not the bridge.
the_war_ender: A war with no door out.
That the peace she made is only the war waiting.
the_penitent_maw: A new bargain — the old appetite asking.
the_pattern_prophet: The pattern completing before anyone understands.
Being understood too late, which is the same as never.
the_unbound_churn: Staying — anywhere, with anyone, long enough to be kept.
That the freedom is only running.
the_one_called_zeus: That he no longer believes it himself.
the_one_called_loki: A bargain that goes perfectly, for the other side.
That the two who walked away glad were lying.
the_one_called_athena: The decision nobody consults her on, that she would have stopped.
the_one_called_ares: Never being asked for anything but this.
Being asked, and not knowing how.
